video_title: Bam Adebayo reflects on his 83-point game, teaming up with Giannis | ESPYS Preview Show

quotes.speaker: Bam Adebayo
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo on the fatigue and context of his 83-point game
quotes.excerpt: Most people don't talk about how exhausted I was. We had guys out, three out of five starters.

text_blocks.speaker: Elle Duncan
text_blocks.text: What do you remember from that night?

text_blocks.speaker: Bam Adebayo
text_blocks.text: Most people don't talk about how exhausted I was. We had guys out, three out of five starters. We were in this funk. I don't know what it was, we were just in this funk. Obviously Dwyane Wade didn't add by saying we had no buzz in the city. Love you Dwyane Wade. I just got going early and it went from there.

quotes.speaker: Bam Adebayo
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo on his shared goal with new teammate Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing is we want to win. You can always be in line with somebody.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Negandhi
text_blocks.text: What's going through your mind now that Giannis Antetokounmpo is going to be a teammate of yours?

text_blocks.speaker: Bam Adebayo
text_blocks.text: The biggest thing is we want to win. You can always be in line with somebody who's about the right stuff and willing to win.

quotes.speaker: Bam Adebayo
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo on the high standard of playing for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: When everybody gets involved when it's Team USA, it's about winning. The standard is gold.
quotes.quote: To be a part of something special like that, obviously when everybody gets involved when it's Team USA, it's about winning. The standard is gold. To be a part of that, to be a part of that run, obviously we had the doubt in our mind down 15 going into the fourth and Stephen Curry became Stephen Curry. To be a part of those type of moments and watch somebody be at the highest stage, excel like that is pretty exciting.

quotes.speaker: Bam Adebayo
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo on the honor of being compared to Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: I feel like everybody is a fan of Kobe and to have my name cemented next to him.
quotes.quote: I feel like everybody is a fan of Kobe and to have my name cemented next to him, doing something that obviously not a lot of people can do, having the opportunity to be a part of that was truly special. And I mean it's 83 points in an NBA game.
